title: Welcome to AS Forge
summary: AS Forge is open. Here is who we are, what we are building and what comes next.
body:
AS Forge is a software company building fast, secure tools. We start small and careful: one product at a time, each built to the same standard.

Our first product, AS Fetchly, is live. Next to it we are working on SentinelAI, a research project on adaptive red teaming and self-improving guardrails for AI assistants, and a cybersecurity toolkit that will be announced soon.

Follow the progress on the Projects page, and write to us on the Contact page if you have an idea or a question.

title: AS Fetchly 0.8.0: one file to install, one click to remove
summary: A single setup file that replaces old versions automatically, plus an Uninstall button inside the app.
body:
AS Fetchly 0.8.0 ships as one setup file. Run it and the app installs itself and opens. If an older version is already installed, it is replaced automatically.

  • Uninstall from Windows Settings, or with the new Uninstall button inside the app.
  • Your settings stay in your user folder unless you delete them.
  • English and Urdu interface.

Get it on the download section. If Windows shows a "protected your PC" screen, click More info, then Run anyway.
